newsitem.title: USA: Cuyahoga County, Ohio, rated Aaa by Moody's.
newsitem.headline: Cuyahoga County, Ohio, rated Aaa by Moody's.

text.p: NEW YORK, June 26, 1997 -- Moody's has assigned a rating of Aaa to the $2.6 million sale of Cuyahoga County, Ohio's Mortgage Revenue Refunding Bonds, Series 1997 C&D (GNMA Collateralized-- Maple Care Center Project). The rating reflects Moody's view of the bond issue's high-quality security provided by a Government National Mortgage Association (GNMA) mortgage-backed security (MBS), a sound legal structure, and cash flow projections exhibiting sufficient revenues to pay debt service.

Fundamental bondholder security is provided by the GNMA guarantee to pay timely principal and interest on the pledged MBS regardless of the performance of the underlying mortgage loans. GNMA, a wholly owned corporate instrumentality of the United States within the Department of Housing and Urban Development, is empowered to guarantee the timely payment of mortgage-backed securities backed by FHA-insured mortgage loans. Additional security is provided by a sound legal structure. The trustee's responsibilities are clearly and specifically defined in that the GNMA MBS will be held at all times by the trustee for the benefit of bondholders. In addition, if payment on the GNMA security is not received in a timely manner, the trustee will notify GNMA and demand timely payment. Cash flow projections also indicate full and timely debt service coverage on the bonds. If a prepayment on the mortgage by HUD results due to a default on the mortgage, sufficient moneys would be available to redeem all outstanding bonds.

Proceeds of the current bonds will be used to current refund Cuyahoga County's Industrial Development Revenue Bonds, Series 1986, which were issued to finance the construction of a nursing, intermediate care facility located in Maple Heights, Cuyahoga.
The outlook for the current issue is stable based on the full faith and credit of the United States pledged to the payment of all amounts under the GNMA guarantee.
Adrienne M. Booker, Analyst, Public Finance Group, Moody's Investors Service
Andrew Lipton, Backup Analyst, Public Finance Group, Moody's Investors Service
Linda Stesney, Director, Public Finance Group, Moody's Investors Service
